{{Quote|At Sooncanoo Beacon, the enemy massacred every crewmember of the Fortieth Flotilla when a bold gambit to boost their shields failed and left them dead in space.|Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="TEGtW cut" />}}
The '''Fortieth Flotilla''' was a unit in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]]. During the [[Waymancy Storm]], it saw action at [[Sooncanoo Beacon]]. During the [[Massacre at Sooncanoo Beacon|battle]], the crew attempted to increase the power of their [[Starship/Legends|ships]]' [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], but failed, stranding them in space without power. The enemy seized the opportunity, [[Death/Legends|killing]] every member of the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. Their sacrifice was later remembered&mdash;25 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later&mdash;in a speech given by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]].<ref name="TEGtW cut" />
